meaning_zh: 家庭或家。
meaning_en: Home or family.
mnemonic_zh: 屋顶下的猪代表古代家庭的财富和安全。
mnemonic_en: A pig under a roof represents the wealth and security of home in ancient times.
meaning_it: Casa o famiglia.
etymology: The oracle bone form shows the roof radical 宀 over a pig 豕, as pigs were valuable domestic animals kept at home. This compound ideograph represents the concept of home through the shelter and livestock that defined ancient households.
mnemonic_it: Un maiale sotto un tetto rappresenta la ricchezza e la sicurezza della casa nei tempi antichi.

meaning_zh: 跟随或从。
meaning_en: To follow or from.
mnemonic_zh: 两个人一前一后走，表示跟随的动作。
mnemonic_en: Two people walking one behind the other, showing the act of following.
meaning_it: Seguire o da.
etymology: The oracle bone script shows two human figures, one following behind the other, creating an ideographic representation of the concept 'to follow'. This compound ideograph uses repeated elements to convey abstract meaning through concrete imagery.
mnemonic_it: Due persone che camminano una dietro l'altra, mostrando l'atto di seguire.

meaning_zh: 数字七，表示数量为七的概念。
meaning_en: The number seven, representing the quantity or concept of seven.
mnemonic_zh: 看起来像被砍断的刀，七次重击后折断。
mnemonic_en: Looks like a knife that has been cut, breaking after seven strikes.
meaning_it: Il numero sette, che rappresenta la quantità o il concetto di sette.
etymology: null
mnemonic_it: Sembra un coltello che è stato tagliato, spezzandosi dopo sette colpi.

meaning_zh: 一万，代表巨大的数量或万物。
meaning_en: Ten thousand, representing an enormous quantity or myriad things.
mnemonic_zh: 上面是草字头下面像蝎子 - 草丛中蝎子多得数不清。
mnemonic_en: A scorpion with grass radical on top - so many scorpions in the grass you can't count them all.
meaning_it: Diecimila, che rappresenta una quantità enorme o una miriade di cose.
etymology: In oracle bone script, 萬 was depicted as a scorpion-like creature, possibly representing the idea of countless small creatures. The connection between the scorpion image and the concept of 'ten thousand' likely arose from the notion of swarming or countless numbers, as scorpions were seen as creatures that appeared in great multitudes.
mnemonic_it: Uno scorpione con il radicale dell'erba sopra - così tanti scorpioni nell'erba che non puoi contarli tutti.

meaning_zh: 数字九，表示八加一的数量。
meaning_en: The number nine, representing the quantity of eight plus one.
mnemonic_zh: null
mnemonic_en: Nine looks like a person bending over with their arm curved at a ninety-degree angle.
meaning_it: Il numero nove, che rappresenta la quantità di otto più uno.
etymology: null
mnemonic_it: null

meaning_zh: 数词，表示数量六。基本数字之一。
meaning_en: The number six. One of the basic numerals.
mnemonic_zh: null
mnemonic_en: Six looks like a roof with a dot underneath, remember a house with six faces
meaning_it: Il numero sei. Uno dei numeri fondamentali.
etymology: null
mnemonic_it: null

meaning_zh: 人的手，用来抓握和操作物体。
meaning_en: The human hand used for grasping and manipulating objects.
mnemonic_zh: 五个手指从手掌伸出，准备抓握。
mnemonic_en: Five fingers extending from a palm, ready to grasp.
meaning_it: La mano umana usata per afferrare e manipolare oggetti.
etymology: The oracle bone form showed a hand with clearly defined fingers and palm. The character evolved to become more angular while maintaining the basic hand structure.
mnemonic_it: Cinque dita che si estendono dal palmo, pronte ad afferrare.

meaning_zh: 太阳或白天。
meaning_en: The sun or day.
mnemonic_zh: 圆圈中间有一点，像太阳里面有黑子。
mnemonic_en: A circle with a dot in the middle looks like the sun with a sunspot.
meaning_it: Il sole o il giorno.
etymology: In oracle bone script, this character depicted a circular sun with a central dot or line. The modern square form evolved from the original round shape through centuries of stylization.
mnemonic_it: Un cerchio con un punto al centro sembra il sole con una macchia solare.

meaning_zh: 鸟类动物。
meaning_en: A bird.
mnemonic_zh: 字形像展开翅膀、垂下双腿的小鸟。
mnemonic_en: The character looks like a bird with spread wings and dangling legs.
meaning_it: Un uccello.
etymology: Oracle bone script showed a detailed bird profile with head, body, wings, and tail clearly visible. The modern simplified form retains the basic bird silhouette but with fewer strokes.
mnemonic_it: Il carattere assomiglia a un uccello con le ali spiegate e le zampe penzoloni.

meaning_zh: 马匹。
meaning_en: A horse.
mnemonic_zh: 三笔勾勒出马儿飘逸的鬃毛侧影。
mnemonic_en: Three strokes show a horse's flowing mane from the side.
meaning_it: Un cavallo.
etymology: In oracle bone script, this was a detailed side view of a horse showing the head, mane, body, and legs. The simplified modern form captures just the essence of the horse's distinctive mane.
mnemonic_it: Tre tratti mostrano la criniera fluente di un cavallo di profilo.

meaning_zh: 观看或注视。
meaning_en: To look at or watch.
mnemonic_zh: 用手遮住眼睛上方，努力看清远处的东西。
mnemonic_en: A hand shading the eyes to get a better look at something.
meaning_it: Guardare o osservare.
etymology: Oracle bone script combined the eye radical with a hand gesture, literally showing someone using their hand to shade their eyes while looking. This composite meaning of 'to look carefully' has remained unchanged for millennia.
mnemonic_it: Una mano che fa ombra agli occhi per vedere meglio qualcosa.

meaning_zh: 指人类或个体的人。
meaning_en: A human being or person.
mnemonic_zh: 像一个人张开双腿走路的样子。
mnemonic_en: A stick figure person with two legs walking forward.
meaning_it: Un essere umano o una persona.
etymology: The oracle bone form depicts a standing human figure in profile with arms and legs clearly visible. This is one of the most fundamental pictographic characters showing the human form.
mnemonic_it: Una figura stilizzata di persona con due gambe che cammina in avanti.

meaning_zh: 指眼睛，用来看东西的器官。
meaning_en: The eye, used for seeing and vision.
mnemonic_zh: 像一只竖立的眼睛，中间有眼珠。
mnemonic_en: A rectangular eye with a pupil in the center looking straight at you.
meaning_it: L'occhio, usato per vedere e la visione.
etymology: The oracle bone character clearly shows an eye in vertical orientation with the pupil depicted as a dark center. The shape evolved from a realistic representation of a human eye viewed frontally.
mnemonic_it: Un occhio rettangolare con la pupilla al centro che ti guarda dritto.

meaning_zh: 指嘴巴，用来吃饭和说话的器官。
meaning_en: The mouth, opening for eating and speaking.
mnemonic_zh: 像张开的嘴巴的方形开口。
mnemonic_en: A square opening like an open mouth ready to speak or eat.
meaning_it: La bocca, apertura per mangiare e parlare.
etymology: The oracle bone form shows a simple rectangular or circular opening representing the human mouth. This pictograph directly depicts the mouth as a hollow opening in the face.
mnemonic_it: Un'apertura quadrata come una bocca aperta pronta a parlare o mangiare.

meaning_zh: 指心脏，也指情感和思想的中心。
meaning_en: The heart, center of emotions and feelings.
mnemonic_zh: 像心脏的形状，有心室和血管分支。
mnemonic_en: The anatomical heart with chambers and vessels branching out.
meaning_it: Il cuore, centro delle emozioni e dei sentimenti.
etymology: The oracle bone character depicts the physical heart organ with its distinctive shape and internal divisions. Ancient Chinese saw the heart as the seat of thought and emotion, not just a physical organ.
mnemonic_it: Il cuore anatomico con camere e vasi che si diramano.

meaning_zh: 龟类爬行动物。
meaning_en: A turtle or tortoise.
mnemonic_zh: 字形像龟壳上伸出头部，还能看到四肢。
mnemonic_en: The character resembles a turtle shell with a head poking out and legs visible.
meaning_it: Una tartaruga.
etymology: Oracle bone script depicted a remarkably detailed turtle from above, showing the distinctive shell pattern, head, and four legs. Ancient Chinese used turtle shells for divination, making this character especially important in early writing.
mnemonic_it: Il carattere ricorda un guscio di tartaruga con la testa che sporge e le zampe visibili.

meaning_zh: 数字一，代表统一和万物的开始。
meaning_en: The number one, representing unity and the beginning of all things.
mnemonic_zh: 一条横线就像竖起的一根手指。
mnemonic_en: A single horizontal line like one finger held up.
meaning_it: Il numero uno, che rappresenta l'unità e l'inizio di tutte le cose.
etymology: In oracle bone script, it was written as a simple horizontal line. This represents the concept of oneness and unity in its most basic form.
mnemonic_it: Una linea orizzontale come un dito alzato.

meaning_zh: 数字二，代表对偶和成双。
meaning_en: The number two, representing duality and pairs.
mnemonic_zh: 两条平行线就像并排竖起的两根手指。
mnemonic_en: Two parallel lines like two fingers held up together.
meaning_it: Il numero due, che rappresenta la dualità e le coppie.
etymology: Oracle bone script showed two horizontal lines stacked vertically. This directly represents the quantity two through visual duplication.
mnemonic_it: Due linee parallele come due dita alzate insieme.

meaning_zh: 数字五，常与中国哲学中的五行相关联。
meaning_en: The number five, often associated with the five elements in Chinese philosophy.
mnemonic_zh: 两横被竖笔交叉，像用五个手指数数。
mnemonic_en: Two horizontal lines crossed by vertical strokes, like counting on five fingers.
meaning_it: Il numero cinque, spesso associato ai cinque elementi nella filosofia cinese.
etymology: The oracle bone form resembled crossed lines representing the intersection of heaven and earth. It evolved to represent the middle number in the ancient counting system of ten.
mnemonic_it: Due linee orizzontali attraversate da tratti verticali, come contare con cinque dita.

meaning_zh: 数字八，在中国文化中被认为是幸运数字。
meaning_en: The number eight, considered a lucky number in Chinese culture.
mnemonic_zh: 两笔分开，像把东西分成八份。
mnemonic_en: Two strokes dividing apart, like splitting something into eight pieces.
meaning_it: Il numero otto, considerato un numero fortunato nella cultura cinese.
etymology: In oracle bones, it appeared as two diverging lines representing division or separation. The shape suggested the concept of splitting or branching into multiple parts, eventually representing eight.
mnemonic_it: Due tratti che si dividono, come dividere qualcosa in otto pezzi.

meaning_zh: 数字一千，代表大量。
meaning_en: The number one thousand, representing a large quantity.
mnemonic_zh: 一个人（人）头上有横线，承载着千的重量。
mnemonic_en: A person (人) with a horizontal line above, carrying the weight of a thousand.
meaning_it: Il numero mille, che rappresenta una grande quantità.
etymology: The oracle bone form combined elements suggesting abundance and multitude. It originally depicted concepts related to many people or great quantities, evolving into the specific number one thousand.
mnemonic_it: Una persona (人) con una linea orizzontale sopra, che porta il peso di mille.

meaning_zh: 高出地面很多的土石构成的高地。
meaning_en: A mountain or hill with peaks and slopes.
mnemonic_zh: 三个山峰连在一起，像山脉的轮廓。
mnemonic_en: Three peaks rising up like a mountain range silhouette.
meaning_it: Una montagna o collina con picchi e pendii.
etymology: The oracle bone form shows three triangular peaks side by side, directly depicting mountain ridges. This pictograph clearly resembles the outline of mountains against the horizon.
mnemonic_it: Tre picchi che si alzano come il profilo di una catena montuosa.

meaning_zh: 物体燃烧时产生的光焰。
meaning_en: Fire, flame, or burning combustion.
mnemonic_zh: 跳动的火焰，火花从底部向上飞舞。
mnemonic_en: Dancing flames with sparks flying upward from the base.
meaning_it: Fuoco, fiamma o combustione ardente.
etymology: The oracle bone script depicts flames rising with characteristic flickering patterns and sparks. The central vertical line represents the main flame while the surrounding strokes show the dancing, irregular nature of fire.
mnemonic_it: Fiamme danzanti con scintille che volano verso l'alto dalla base.

meaning_zh: 无色无味的液体，江河湖海的主要成分。
meaning_en: Water in liquid form, flowing or still.
mnemonic_zh: 流动的小溪，波纹和水流向下流淌。
mnemonic_en: Flowing stream with ripples and currents moving downward.
meaning_it: Acqua in forma liquida, che scorre o ferma.
etymology: The oracle bone form shows a central flow line with smaller streams or ripples on both sides. This captures the essential nature of water as a flowing, branching substance that moves in channels and tributaries.
mnemonic_it: Ruscello che scorre con increspature e correnti verso il basso.

meaning_zh: 种植农作物的土地。
meaning_en: A cultivated field or farmland for growing crops.
mnemonic_zh: 方形的农田被灌溉沟渠分割开来。
mnemonic_en: Square plots of farmland divided by irrigation channels.
meaning_it: Un campo coltivato o terreno agricolo per la coltivazione.
etymology: The oracle bone script shows rectangular field plots with clear boundary lines and divisions. This represents the ancient Chinese practice of dividing agricultural land into organized, geometric sections for efficient farming and water management.
mnemonic_it: Appezzamenti quadrati di terreno agricolo divisi da canali di irrigazione.

meaning_zh: 从天空中的云落下的水滴。
meaning_en: Rain falling from clouds as water droplets.
mnemonic_zh: 水平的云朵上方，许多雨滴直直落下。
mnemonic_en: Horizontal clouds above with many raindrops falling straight down.
meaning_it: Pioggia che cade dalle nuvole come goccioline d'acqua.
etymology: The oracle bone form depicts the sky or clouds at the top with multiple vertical lines representing falling raindrops. The horizontal strokes represent the cloud layer from which rain originates, while the vertical lines clearly show precipitation descending to earth.
mnemonic_it: Nuvole orizzontali sopra con molte gocce di pioggia che cadono dritte.

meaning_zh: 指人的身体或躯体。
meaning_en: The body or physical form of a person.
mnemonic_zh: 像怀孕妇女的侧面轮廓，显示出身体的形状。
mnemonic_en: A pregnant woman's profile showing the swollen belly and body shape.
meaning_it: Il corpo o la forma fisica di una persona.
etymology: The oracle bone form shows a human figure with an enlarged midsection, possibly representing pregnancy as the ultimate expression of the body. This emphasizes the body as a vessel for life and physical existence.
mnemonic_it: Il profilo di una donna incinta che mostra il ventre gonfio e la forma del corpo.

meaning_zh: 数字三。
meaning_en: The number three.
mnemonic_zh: 三条横线像三层楼房叠在一起。
mnemonic_en: Three horizontal lines stacked like three floors of a building.
meaning_it: Il numero tre.
etymology: In oracle bone script, three was represented by three horizontal strokes, directly showing the quantity. This is one of the clearest examples of numerical representation in early Chinese writing.
mnemonic_it: Tre linee orizzontali impilate come tre piani di un edificio.

meaning_zh: 数字十。
meaning_en: The number ten.
mnemonic_zh: 像十字架，表示双手数完了十个数。
mnemonic_en: A cross marking the completion of counting on both hands.
meaning_it: Il numero dieci.
etymology: In oracle bone script, ten was written as a vertical line crossed by a horizontal line, symbolizing completeness. This cross shape represented the full cycle of counting and became the basis for the decimal system.
mnemonic_it: Come una croce che segna il completamento del conteggio su entrambe le mani.

meaning_zh: 数字一百。
meaning_en: The number one hundred.
mnemonic_zh: 白色的米粒多得数不清，达到一百粒。
mnemonic_en: White rice grains so numerous they reach a hundred.
meaning_it: Il numero cento.
etymology: The oracle bone form combined the concept of 'white' with numerical marks to represent a large quantity. The character evolved from pictographic representations of counting marks or tally systems used for large numbers.
mnemonic_it: Chicchi di riso bianco così numerosi da raggiungere il centinaio.

meaning_zh: 数字一万。
meaning_en: The number ten thousand.
mnemonic_zh: 像蝎子有无数后代，代表一万个。
mnemonic_en: A scorpion with countless offspring representing ten thousand.
meaning_it: Il numero diecimila.
etymology: Originally depicted a scorpion in oracle bone script, chosen because scorpions were associated with vast numbers due to their prolific reproduction. The connection between the creature and the large number became conventionalized over time.
mnemonic_it: Come uno scorpione con innumerevoli discendenti che rappresenta diecimila.

meaning_zh: 零是表示没有或空值的数字。
meaning_en: Zero is the numerical digit representing nothing or null value.
mnemonic_zh: 雨滴飘落代表零的空虚——没有实质的东西留下。
mnemonic_en: Rain drops falling represent the emptiness of zero - nothing substantial remains.
meaning_it: Zero è la cifra numerica che rappresenta il nulla o un valore nullo.
etymology: Originally depicted scattered raindrops or small fragments. The concept evolved to represent the absence of quantity or emptiness.
mnemonic_it: Le gocce di pioggia che cadono rappresentano il vuoto dello zero - non rimane nulla di sostanziale.

meaning_zh: 双表示成对或两个相同的东西在一起。
meaning_en: Double means a pair or two of the same kind together.
mnemonic_zh: 两只手握在一起显示了成对或双倍的概念。
mnemonic_en: Two hands grasping together show the concept of a pair or double.
meaning_it: Doppio significa una coppia o due della stessa specie insieme.
etymology: Oracle bone form showed two hands or two identical objects side by side. This naturally evolved to represent the concept of pairs and doubles.
mnemonic_it: Due mani che si afferrano insieme mostrano il concetto di coppia o doppio.

meaning_zh: 半表示某物被分成两个相等部分中的一个。
meaning_en: Half means one of two equal parts of something divided.
mnemonic_zh: 一头牛从中间分开显示了清楚的一分为二。
mnemonic_en: A cow split down the middle shows the clear division into halves.
meaning_it: Metà significa una delle due parti uguali di qualcosa diviso.
etymology: Oracle bone script depicted an object split vertically down the middle. The splitting line clearly showed the division into two equal parts.
mnemonic_it: Una mucca divisa nel mezzo mostra la chiara divisione in metà.

meaning_zh: 兆表示极大的数字，最初意思是征兆。
meaning_en: Trillion represents an extremely large number, originally meaning omen.
mnemonic_zh: 龟壳占卜的裂纹预示着无数未来的可能性如万亿。
mnemonic_en: Cracks in turtle shell divination predict countless future possibilities like trillions.
meaning_it: Trilione rappresenta un numero estremamente grande, originariamente significava presagio.
etymology: Originally showed cracks on oracle bones used for divination rituals. The countless crack patterns led to its association with vast numbers.
mnemonic_it: Le crepe nella divinazione del guscio di tartaruga predicono innumerevoli possibilità future come trilioni.

meaning_zh: 亿在中国数字系统中表示巨大的数量。
meaning_en: Hundred million represents an enormous quantity in the Chinese numerical system.
mnemonic_zh: 一个人被一亿个事物的巨大数量所压倒。
mnemonic_en: A person overwhelmed by the vastness of a hundred million things.
meaning_it: Cento milioni rappresenta una quantità enorme nel sistema numerico cinese.
etymology: Combined the person radical with phonetic elements to represent vast quantities. The human element emphasized the incomprehensible scale from a person's perspective.
mnemonic_it: Una persona sopraffatta dalla vastità di cento milioni di cose.

meaning_zh: 天干第四位，也指成年男子或立方体。
meaning_en: The fourth position in the traditional Chinese decimal system, also meaning 'adult male' or 'cube'.
mnemonic_zh: 像钉子一样笔直向下，简单直接地表示数字。
mnemonic_en: A nail (丁) hammered straight down - simple and direct like the number it represents.
meaning_it: La quarta posizione nel sistema decimale tradizionale cinese, significa anche 'maschio adulto' o 'cubo'.
etymology: In oracle bone script, 丁 appeared as a straight vertical line with a horizontal top, resembling a nail or peg. It was used as the fourth stem in the decimal counting system and represented stability and firmness.
mnemonic_it: Come un chiodo (丁) piantato dritto - semplice e diretto come il numero che rappresenta.

meaning_zh: 天干第六位，也指自己、本身。
meaning_en: The sixth position in the traditional Chinese decimal system, also meaning 'self' or 'oneself'.
mnemonic_zh: 弯曲的形状像人弯腰看自己，在序列中排第六。
mnemonic_en: The curved shape looks like a person bending to look at themselves - the sixth in sequence.
meaning_it: La sesta posizione nel sistema decimale tradizionale cinese, significa anche 'se stesso'.
etymology: The oracle bone form of 己 depicted a curved line resembling a person in profile or a coiled rope. It served as the sixth heavenly stem in the traditional counting system and developed the meaning of 'self' from its use in personal reference.
mnemonic_it: La forma curva sembra una persona che si piega per guardarsi - il sesto nella sequenza.

meaning_zh: 天干第一位，也指甲壳或盔甲。
meaning_en: The first position in the traditional Chinese decimal system, also meaning 'shell' or 'armor'.
mnemonic_zh: 战士的盔甲，在保护中排第一，在计数序列中也排第一。
mnemonic_en: A warrior's armor (甲) - first in protection, first in the counting sequence.
meaning_it: La prima posizione nel sistema decimale tradizionale cinese, significa anche 'guscio' o 'armatura'.
etymology: In oracle bone inscriptions, 甲 resembled a turtle shell or piece of armor with a protective covering. As the first heavenly stem, it represented the beginning of cycles and was associated with wood element in traditional Chinese cosmology.
mnemonic_it: L'armatura di un guerriero (甲) - prima nella protezione, prima nella sequenza numerica.

meaning_zh: 天干第二位，代表木元素。
meaning_en: The second position in the traditional Chinese decimal system, representing the wood element.
mnemonic_zh: 一笔弯曲的笔画像幼苗的嫩芽，在自然顺序中排第二。
mnemonic_en: A single curved stroke like a young plant shoot - second in the natural order.
meaning_it: La seconda posizione nel sistema decimale tradizionale cinese, rappresenta l'elemento legno.
etymology: The oracle bone character 乙 appeared as a curved line resembling a sprouting plant or a winding path. As the second heavenly stem in the decimal system, it symbolized growth and flexibility, embodying the wood element's characteristics of bending without breaking.
mnemonic_it: Un singolo tratto curvo come un germoglio giovane - secondo nell'ordine naturale.

meaning_zh: 天干第七位，代表金元素和更新。
meaning_en: The seventh position in the traditional Chinese decimal system, representing the metal element and renewal.
mnemonic_zh: 在庇护下，变化发生，第七位天干带来转换。
mnemonic_en: Under the shelter (广), change (更) occurs - the seventh stem brings transformation.
meaning_it: La settima posizione nel sistema decimale tradizionale cinese, rappresenta l'elemento metallo e il rinnovamento.
etymology: Oracle bone script showed 庚 as a combination suggesting a pestle or grinding tool under a shelter, symbolizing transformation and refinement. As the seventh heavenly stem associated with metal element, it represented the process of change and the hardness that comes through refinement.
mnemonic_it: Sotto il riparo (广), avviene il cambiamento (更) - il settimo stelo porta trasformazione.

meaning_zh: 木头或树木，代表所有木本植物和木材。
meaning_en: Wood or tree, representing all woody plants and timber.
mnemonic_zh: 一棵树，下有根，中有干，上有枝叶伸展。
mnemonic_en: A tree with roots below, trunk in middle, and branches spreading above.
meaning_it: Legno o albero, rappresenta tutte le piante legnose e il legname.
etymology: The oracle bone form clearly depicts a tree with roots extending downward and branches reaching upward. This pictograph became the fundamental radical for all tree and wood-related characters.
mnemonic_it: Un albero con radici sotto, tronco al centro e rami che si espandono sopra.

meaning_zh: 月亮，也用作表示肉体或身体部位的偏旁。
meaning_en: Moon, also used as a radical meaning flesh or body parts.
mnemonic_zh: 弯弯的月牙形状，两条横线显示月相变化。
mnemonic_en: A crescent moon shape with two horizontal lines showing its phases.
meaning_it: Luna, usata anche come radicale per indicare carne o parti del corpo.
etymology: The oracle bone script shows a clear crescent moon shape, sometimes with dots representing craters or shadows. Over time it evolved into the current rectangular form while maintaining its lunar meaning.
mnemonic_it: Forma di luna crescente con due linee orizzontali che mostrano le fasi lunari.

meaning_zh: 石头或岩石，代表坚硬的矿物质。
meaning_en: Stone or rock, representing hard mineral substances.
mnemonic_zh: 悬崖峭壁上有石头滚落下来的样子。
mnemonic_en: A cliff face with a falling rock or stone breaking away.
meaning_it: Pietra o roccia, rappresenta sostanze minerali dure.
etymology: The oracle bone form depicts a cliff or rock face with a stone or boulder at its base. This pictograph represents the hardness and permanence of stone in nature.
mnemonic_it: Una parete rocciosa con una pietra che cade o si stacca.

meaning_zh: 草或从地面生长的草本植物。
meaning_en: Grass or herbaceous plants growing from the ground.
mnemonic_zh: 上面是草字头，下面是幼苗从土里钻出来。
mnemonic_en: The grass radical on top with early sprouts emerging from soil below.
meaning_it: Erba o piante erbacee che crescono dal suolo.
etymology: The oracle bone script shows multiple grass blades growing upward from the earth. The character combines the grass radical with elements suggesting early growth and sprouting.
mnemonic_it: Il radicale dell'erba sopra con giovani germogli che emergono dal terreno sotto.

meaning_zh: 茂密的森林，许多树木紧密生长在一起。
meaning_en: Dense forest with many trees growing closely together.
mnemonic_zh: 三棵树紧密排列，形成茂密阴暗的森林。
mnemonic_en: Three trees crowded together creating a dense, dark forest.
meaning_it: Foresta densa con molti alberi che crescono fittamente insieme.
etymology: This character compounds three 木 (tree) characters to represent multiplicity and density. The oracle bone origins show how ancient Chinese used repetition to indicate abundance in nature.
mnemonic_it: Tre alberi affollati insieme che creano una foresta densa e scura.

meaning_zh: 年，指地球绕太阳一周的时间单位。
meaning_en: Year, a period of time marking the completion of Earth's orbit around the sun.
mnemonic_zh: 一个人背着谷物的形象，收获时节标志着一年的结束。
mnemonic_en: A person carrying grain on their back - harvest time marks the year's end.
meaning_it: Anno, un periodo di tempo che segna il completamento dell'orbita terrestre intorno al sole.
etymology: Oracle bone form shows a person carrying grain, representing the agricultural cycle that defined the year. The character evolved to represent the concept of annual time periods.
mnemonic_it: Una persona che porta il grano sulla schiena - il tempo del raccolto segna la fine dell'anno.

meaning_zh: 夕阳，指太阳下山、天色渐暗的时候。
meaning_en: Evening, the time of day when the sun sets and darkness approaches.
mnemonic_zh: 月牙形状，象征白天渐渐消失，夜晚来临。
mnemonic_en: A crescent moon shape appearing as daylight fades into evening.
meaning_it: Sera, il momento del giorno in cui il sole tramonta e si avvicina l'oscurità.
etymology: The oracle bone form depicts a crescent or partial moon, symbolizing the evening time when the moon becomes visible. This pictograph directly represents the transition from day to night.
mnemonic_it: Una forma di mezzaluna che appare mentre la luce del giorno svanisce nella sera.

meaning_zh: 现在，指当前的时间或此刻。
meaning_en: Now, the present time or current moment.
mnemonic_zh: 一个人头上戴着帽子，表示此时此刻在场的人。
mnemonic_en: A person with a cap on top - representing someone present right now.
meaning_it: Ora, il tempo presente o il momento attuale.
etymology: Oracle bone script shows a person with something covering or above them, indicating presence in the current moment. The covering element emphasizes the immediacy of 'now'.
mnemonic_it: Una persona con un berretto in testa - rappresenta qualcuno presente proprio ora.

meaning_zh: 早晨，指一天的开始时间或清晨时分。
meaning_en: Early, morning, or the beginning part of the day.
mnemonic_zh: 太阳升起照耀草地，清晨时分草上还有露水。
mnemonic_en: The sun rising above grass - early morning when dew covers the plants.
meaning_it: Presto, mattina, o la parte iniziale del giorno.
etymology: Oracle bone form combines sun and grass elements, depicting the early morning scene when the sun rises over vegetation. This compound character illustrates the natural markers of early time.
mnemonic_it: Il sole che sorge sopra l'erba - la mattina presto quando la rugiada copre le piante.

meaning_zh: 春天，万物复苏、植物开始生长的温暖季节。
meaning_en: Spring, the season of renewal when plants begin to grow and weather warms.
mnemonic_zh: 阳光照耀着正在发芽的草木，下面有根系，象征春天万物复苏。
mnemonic_en: Sun shining on sprouting grass with roots below - nature awakening in spring.
meaning_it: Primavera, la stagione del rinnovamento quando le piante iniziano a crescere e il clima si scalda.
etymology: Oracle bone script shows the sun above sprouting vegetation, capturing the essence of spring's renewal. The character combines natural elements to represent this crucial seasonal time period.
mnemonic_it: Il sole che splende sull'erba che germoglia con le radici sotto - la natura che si risveglia in primavera.

meaning_zh: 大小的大，表示体积、面积、数量等方面超过一般。
meaning_en: Big or large in size or importance.
mnemonic_zh: 一个人张开手脚显示自己很大的样子。
mnemonic_en: A person stretching arms and legs wide to show how BIG they are.
meaning_it: Grande o ampio in dimensione o importanza.
etymology: The oracle bone form shows a human figure with arms and legs spread wide. This pictograph directly represents the concept of largeness through the image of a person making themselves appear as big as possible.
mnemonic_it: Una persona che allarga braccia e gambe per mostrare quanto è GRANDE.

meaning_zh: 女性，成年的女子。
meaning_en: Woman or female person.
mnemonic_zh: 一个优雅跪坐的女性形象。
mnemonic_en: A graceful figure kneeling in traditional feminine posture.
meaning_it: Donna o persona di sesso femminile.
etymology: The oracle bone script depicts a kneeling female figure with crossed hands. This pictograph captures the traditional posture associated with women in ancient Chinese society.
mnemonic_it: Una figura elegante inginocchiata in postura femminile tradizionale.

meaning_zh: 生活在水中的脊椎动物。
meaning_en: Fish that lives in water.
mnemonic_zh: 一条有着大头、身体、鱼鳍和特别尾巴的游鱼。
mnemonic_en: A fish with a big head, body, fins, and distinctive tail swimming.
meaning_it: Pesce che vive nell'acqua.
etymology: The oracle bone form clearly shows a fish with head, body, scales, and tail fin. This pictograph captures all the essential visual elements that identify a fish swimming in water.
mnemonic_it: Un pesce con una grande testa, corpo, pinne e coda distintiva che nuota.

meaning_zh: 用于运输的车辆或马车。
meaning_en: Vehicle or cart used for transportation.
mnemonic_zh: 从上面看到的车子，显示车轴和两个轮子。
mnemonic_en: A cart viewed from above showing the axle and two wheels.
meaning_it: Veicolo o carro usato per il trasporto.
etymology: The oracle bone script shows a bird's-eye view of a wheeled vehicle with an axle connecting two wheels. This aerial perspective clearly depicts the essential structure of ancient Chinese carts and chariots.
mnemonic_it: Un carro visto dall'alto che mostra l'asse e le due ruote.

meaning_zh: 中国神话传说中的神异动物，能兴云降雨。
meaning_en: Dragon, a legendary creature in Chinese mythology.
mnemonic_zh: 一条蛇形的神兽，有着流动的身体、特别的头部和神奇的力量。
mnemonic_en: A serpentine creature with flowing body, distinctive head, and magical powers.
meaning_it: Drago, una creatura leggendaria nella mitologia cinese.
etymology: The oracle bone form depicts a large serpentine creature with an elaborate head featuring horns or crests. This mythical being represents the ancient Chinese conception of a powerful dragon that could control weather and water.
mnemonic_it: Una creatura serpentina con corpo fluente, testa distintiva e poteri magici.

meaning_zh: 数字四，表示数量为四的概念。
meaning_en: The number four, representing the quantity or concept of four.
mnemonic_zh: 像张开的嘴巴，里面有四个分割。
mnemonic_en: Four corners trapped inside a square frame, like four people locked in a room.
meaning_it: Il numero quattro, che rappresenta la quantità o il concetto di quattro.
etymology: The oracle bone form showed four strokes or divisions within an enclosure. The character evolved to represent the abstract concept of fourness through geometric division.
mnemonic_it: Come una bocca aperta con quattro divisioni all'interno.

meaning_zh: 红色，赤色。象征热情、喜庆或革命。
meaning_en: The color red. Symbolizes passion, celebration, or revolution.
mnemonic_zh: null
mnemonic_en: Silk thread worker dyes it red
meaning_it: Il colore rosso. Simboleggia passione, celebrazione o rivoluzione.
etymology: null
mnemonic_it: null

meaning_zh: 用来切割东西的刀具。
meaning_en: A knife or blade used for cutting.
mnemonic_zh: 甲骨文像弯曲的刀刃带着手柄，想象武士的剑。
mnemonic_en: The oracle bone looks like a curved blade with a handle - imagine a warrior's sword.
meaning_it: Un coltello o lama usata per tagliare.
etymology: The oracle bone form clearly depicts a knife with a curved blade and handle. The pictograph directly represents the physical shape of this essential tool.
mnemonic_it: L'osso oracolare sembra una lama curva con manico - immagina la spada di un guerriero.

meaning_zh: 一种大型家畜，即牛。
meaning_en: An ox or cow, a large domesticated bovine animal.
mnemonic_zh: 甲骨文显示牛头，两只角向上突出。
mnemonic_en: The oracle bone shows a cow's head with prominent horns pointing upward.
meaning_it: Un bue o mucca, un grande animale bovino domestico.
etymology: The oracle bone character depicts the frontal view of an ox's head with two prominent horns. This pictograph captures the most distinctive feature of cattle - their horns.
mnemonic_it: L'osso oracolare mostra una testa di mucca con corna prominenti rivolte verso l'alto.

meaning_zh: 人或动物的脚，用来行走的下肢。
meaning_en: Foot or leg, the lower limb used for walking.
mnemonic_zh: 甲骨文显示从膝盖到脚的完整腿部，像走路的侧面图。
mnemonic_en: The oracle bone shows a complete leg from knee to foot, like a side view of someone walking.
meaning_it: Piede o gamba, l'arto inferiore usato per camminare.
etymology: The oracle bone form depicts a human leg and foot in profile, showing the knee joint and foot clearly. This pictograph emphasizes the foot's function in locomotion.
mnemonic_it: L'osso oracolare mostra una gamba completa dal ginocchio al piede, come una vista laterale di qualcuno che cammina.

meaning_zh: 从别处到这里，表示到达。
meaning_en: To come or arrive from another place.
mnemonic_zh: 甲骨文像麦穗摇摆，有人穿过田野走来。
mnemonic_en: The oracle bone looks like wheat stalks swaying as someone approaches through a field.
meaning_it: Venire o arrivare da un altro posto.
etymology: The oracle bone character originally depicted wheat or grain plants, symbolizing the harvest coming in. The concept of 'coming' derived from the idea of crops arriving at maturity.
mnemonic_it: L'osso oracolare sembra spighe di grano che ondeggiano mentre qualcuno si avvicina attraverso un campo.

meaning_zh: 猪，古代汉语中指猪类动物。
meaning_en: A pig or swine, especially in ancient Chinese contexts.
mnemonic_zh: 甲骨文显示猪的身体，弯曲的背部，短腿，鼻子向下觅食。
mnemonic_en: The oracle bone shows a pig's body with distinctive curved back, short legs, and snout pointing down to root for food.
meaning_it: Un maiale o suino, specialmente nei contesti cinesi antichi.
etymology: The oracle bone form is a detailed pictograph showing a pig in profile with its characteristic curved spine, short legs, and downward-pointing snout. This character served as an important radical in many compound characters related to domestic animals.
mnemonic_it: L'osso oracolare mostra il corpo di un maiale con schiena curva distintiva, zampe corte e muso rivolto verso il basso per cercare cibo.

meaning_zh: 一种家畜，用于提供羊毛、肉类和奶制品。
meaning_en: A domesticated animal raised for wool, meat, and milk.
mnemonic_zh: 甲骨文像羊头，上面有弯曲的羊角。
mnemonic_en: The oracle bone shows a sheep's head with curved horns on top.
meaning_it: Un animale domestico allevato per lana, carne e latte.
etymology: The oracle bone character depicts a sheep's head viewed from the front, with prominent curved horns at the top. The vertical line represents the face, while the horizontal strokes show the distinctive horn shape.
mnemonic_it: L'osso oracolare mostra una testa di pecora con corna curve in alto.

meaning_zh: 狗，特别指大型犬或正式场合用词。
meaning_en: A dog, especially referring to larger breeds or in formal contexts.
mnemonic_zh: 甲骨文像侧面的狗，有弯曲的尾巴和警觉的姿态。
mnemonic_en: The oracle bone shows a dog in profile with a curved tail and alert posture.
meaning_it: Un cane, specialmente riferito a razze di taglia grande o in contesti formali.
etymology: The oracle bone character depicts a dog in side view, showing its characteristic curved tail and alert stance. The dot often represents the eye, emphasizing the dog's watchful nature.
mnemonic_it: L'osso oracolare mostra un cane di profilo con coda curva e postura vigile.

meaning_zh: 门户，供人通过墙壁或屏障的开口。
meaning_en: A door or gate that allows passage through a wall or barrier.
mnemonic_zh: 甲骨文像两扇可以开合的门板。
mnemonic_en: The oracle bone shows two door panels that swing open and closed.
meaning_it: Una porta o cancello che permette il passaggio attraverso un muro o barriera.
etymology: The oracle bone character depicts a double-leafed door or gate with two panels. The symmetrical design shows how ancient doors were typically made with two halves that could swing open.
mnemonic_it: L'osso oracolare mostra due pannelli di porta che si aprono e chiudono.

meaning_zh: 船只，用于在江河湖泊上运输的小型水上交通工具。
meaning_en: A boat or small watercraft used for transportation on rivers and lakes.
mnemonic_zh: 甲骨文像从上往下看的船身，两端尖尖的。
mnemonic_en: The oracle bone shows a boat's hull viewed from above with pointed ends.
meaning_it: Una barca o piccola imbarcazione usata per il trasporto su fiumi e laghi.
etymology: The oracle bone character represents a boat viewed from above, showing the elongated hull with pointed bow and stern. The central line often represents the interior space or keel of the vessel.
mnemonic_it: L'osso oracolare mostra lo scafo di una barca visto dall'alto con estremità appuntite.

meaning_zh: 古代青铜三足器皿，用于烹饪和祭祀仪式。
meaning_en: An ancient bronze tripod vessel used for cooking and ritual ceremonies.
mnemonic_zh: 甲骨文像有三条腿、把手和盖子的祭祀大鼎。
mnemonic_en: The oracle bone shows a ritual cauldron with three legs, handles, and a lid.
meaning_it: Un antico vaso di bronzo a tre piedi usato per cucinare e cerimonie rituali.
etymology: The oracle bone character depicts a bronze tripod cauldron with three legs for stability over fire, two handles for lifting, and often a lid. These vessels were essential for both cooking and religious ceremonies in ancient China.
mnemonic_it: L'osso oracolare mostra un calderone rituale con tre gambe, manici e coperchio.

meaning_zh: 大米或谷物，主要的粮食作物。
meaning_en: Rice or grain, a staple food crop.
mnemonic_zh: 六个散落的点像从袋子里洒出的米粒。
mnemonic_en: Six scattered dots like rice grains spilling from a bag.
meaning_it: Riso o cereali, un raccolto alimentare principale.
etymology: The oracle bone form shows scattered grains or seeds arranged in a cross pattern. This pictograph directly represents the appearance of rice or millet grains.
mnemonic_it: Sei punti sparsi come chicchi di riso che cadono da un sacco.

meaning_zh: 耳朵，听觉器官。
meaning_en: Ear, the organ of hearing.
mnemonic_zh: 弯曲的线条勾勒出人耳的轮廓。
mnemonic_en: The curved lines trace the outline of a human ear.
meaning_it: Orecchio, l'organo dell'udito.
etymology: The oracle bone character clearly depicts the shape of a human ear in profile. The curved outer line represents the ear's outer rim while inner strokes show the ear canal.
mnemonic_it: Le linee curve tracciano il contorno di un orecchio umano.

meaning_zh: 昆虫或虫子，小的爬行生物。
meaning_en: Insect or worm, small crawling creature.
mnemonic_zh: 一个弯曲身体像蛇一样蠕动的生物。
mnemonic_en: A wriggling snake-like creature with a curved body.
meaning_it: Insetto o verme, piccola creatura strisciante.
etymology: The oracle bone form depicts a snake or worm-like creature with a curved, segmented body. Originally it represented various crawling creatures including snakes, worms, and insects.
mnemonic_it: Una creatura serpentina che si contorce con il corpo curvo.

meaning_zh: 走路或跑步，用脚移动。
meaning_en: To walk or run, to move on foot.
mnemonic_zh: 一个人摆动双臂大步向前走。
mnemonic_en: A person with swinging arms taking big strides forward.
meaning_it: Camminare o correre, muoversi a piedi.
etymology: The oracle bone character shows a person in motion with arms swinging. The top part represents the torso and arms while the bottom shows the legs in a walking stance.
mnemonic_it: Una persona con le braccia oscillanti che fa grandi passi in avanti.

meaning_zh: 雷声，暴风雨中伴随闪电的声音。
meaning_en: Thunder, the sound accompanying lightning in storms.
mnemonic_zh: 上面是雨云，下面是田野，展现自然的电力。
mnemonic_en: Rain clouds above with field below, nature's electric power display.
meaning_it: Tuono, il suono che accompagna i fulmini nelle tempeste.
etymology: The oracle bone form combines the rain radical at the top with field-like patterns below, representing the agricultural impact of thunderstorms. This compound character shows how thunder and rain affect farming.
mnemonic_it: Nuvole di pioggia sopra con campo sotto, spettacolo del potere elettrico della natura.

meaning_zh: 孩子或儿子，代表后代和年幼的人。
meaning_en: A child or son, representing offspring and young people.
mnemonic_zh: 一个大头小身体的婴儿被布包着。
mnemonic_en: A baby with a big head and tiny body swaddled in cloth.
meaning_it: Un bambino o figlio, che rappresenta la prole e i giovani.
etymology: The oracle bone form shows a baby with a large head and small body, emphasizing the proportions of an infant. The character depicts arms outstretched, symbolizing a child reaching out.
mnemonic_it: Un neonato con una testa grande e un corpicino avvolto in un panno.

meaning_zh: 用来捕鱼或捕鸟的网，或网络结构。
meaning_en: A net used for catching fish or birds, or a network structure.
mnemonic_zh: 交叉的绳子形成渔网，有清晰的网格图案。
mnemonic_en: Crossed strings forming a fishing net with a clear grid pattern.
meaning_it: Una rete usata per catturare pesci o uccelli, o una struttura di rete.
etymology: The oracle bone script shows intersecting lines forming a mesh pattern, directly depicting a hunting or fishing net. The ancient form clearly resembles the woven structure of nets used by early hunters and fishermen.
mnemonic_it: Corde incrociate che formano una rete da pesca con un motivo a griglia chiaro.

meaning_zh: 老鼠，代表小型啮齿动物。
meaning_en: A mouse or rat, representing small rodents.
mnemonic_zh: 一只有突出牙齿、长尾巴和四条腿的啮齿动物在跑来跑去。
mnemonic_en: A rodent with prominent teeth, long tail, and four legs scurrying around.
meaning_it: Un topo o ratto, che rappresenta i piccoli roditori.
etymology: The oracle bone form depicts a small animal with a long tail, pointed snout, and visible teeth. The character clearly shows the distinctive features of a rodent, with emphasis on the tail and gnawing teeth that characterize mice and rats.
mnemonic_it: Un roditore con denti prominenti, coda lunga e quattro zampe che scorrazza.

meaning_zh: 通过发酵制成的酒精饮料或酒。
meaning_en: Alcoholic beverage or wine made through fermentation.
mnemonic_zh: 一个装着液体的陶罐，代表储存在容器中的发酵饮料。
mnemonic_en: A clay jar with liquid inside, representing fermented beverages stored in vessels.
meaning_it: Bevanda alcolica o vino prodotto attraverso la fermentazione.
etymology: The oracle bone form shows a ceremonial wine vessel with liquid drops, indicating alcohol used in rituals. The character combines the radical for wine vessel (酉) with drops, symbolizing the precious fermented liquid used in ancient ceremonies.
mnemonic_it: Un vaso di argilla con del liquido dentro, che rappresenta bevande fermentate conservate in contenitori.

meaning_zh: 弓，用来射箭的武器。
meaning_en: Bow, a weapon used for shooting arrows.
mnemonic_zh: 一把弯曲的弓准备射箭。
mnemonic_en: A curved bow ready to shoot an arrow.
meaning_it: Arco, un'arma usata per tirare frecce.
etymology: The oracle bone script shows the curved shape of a bow with its string. The pictograph directly represents the weapon's distinctive arched form used in ancient hunting and warfare.
mnemonic_it: Un arco curvo pronto a scagliare una freccia.

meaning_zh: 井，挖掘的深洞用来取地下水。
meaning_en: Well, a deep hole dug to access underground water.
mnemonic_zh: 一个方形的井，四角有木制框架支撑。
mnemonic_en: A square well with wooden frame supports at the corners.
meaning_it: Pozzo, un buco profondo scavato per accedere all'acqua sotterranea.
etymology: The oracle bone form depicts a well with its square opening and supporting framework. The ancient character shows the structural elements needed to maintain a water well's integrity.
mnemonic_it: Un pozzo quadrato con supporti di legno agli angoli.

meaning_zh: 角，尖锐的突出物或有角度的边缘。
meaning_en: Horn or corner, a pointed projection or angular edge.
mnemonic_zh: 动物的角，有尖锐的顶端和弯曲的底部。
mnemonic_en: An animal's horn with its pointed tip and curved base.
meaning_it: Corno o angolo, una sporgenza appuntita o un bordo angolare.
etymology: The oracle bone script shows an animal horn with its characteristic curved shape and pointed end. The ancient form clearly depicts the horn's natural structure as seen on cattle and other horned animals.
mnemonic_it: Il corno di un animale con la punta aguzza e la base curva.

meaning_zh: 祭祀，为了纪念祖先或神灵而举行的仪式。
meaning_en: Sacrifice or ritual ceremony to honor ancestors or deities.
mnemonic_zh: 双手在祭坛上向上天神灵献上肉食。
mnemonic_en: Hands offering meat on an altar to the spirits above.
meaning_it: Sacrificio o cerimonia rituale per onorare antenati o divinità.
etymology: The oracle bone form shows a hand holding meat over an altar or sacrificial table. This complex pictograph combines elements representing the ritual offering of food to ancestors or gods in ancient Chinese religious practices.
mnemonic_it: Mani che offrono carne su un altare agli spiriti celesti.
